Five thousand years ago, we faced the flood just like the people of Inazuma 😊 Four thousand years ago, we played with bronze ware just like the people of Mondstadt 🤗 Three thousand years ago, we pondered philosophy just like the people of Sumeru 🧐 Two thousand years ago, we marched to war just like the people of Natlan 😠 One thousand years ago, we were just as prosperous as the people of Fontaine 🥳 And now, we go head to head with the people of Snezhnaya 😈 For five thousand years we have sat at the world's table 😎 while our opponents have already been swapped out several times 😱 Rise up, people of Liyue 💪💪💪 For the Rex Lapis 💃💃💃
Once, there was a kingdom in the heavens filled with spiky-haired gods, and their boss was called "Lord Commander of the Divine Firmament Something Thunderbolt Demon-Chasing Who Cleans the Toilets Every Day", named Jingyuanyuan, short for Jingyuan. Jingyuan had seven daughters; the youngest was called the Balladeer, said to be the hottest and most beautiful flower, deeply favored by Jingyuanyuan. The kingdom had one rule: you could not fall in love with mortals, so you could not go down to the human world. But the Balladeer was far too curious about the human world, so he kept it from Jingyuanyuan and jumped off the Immortal-Execution Platform. The first thing he did after descending was take a bath, but unexpectedly a trash can saw everything, so the Balladeer blushed in shyness and would marry no one but the trash can. And so, after that fated encounter, the Balladeer and the trash can lived happily together - but this was soon known to Jingyuanyuan in the heavens. He was absolutely furious, roared a curse, flying-kicked the trash can far away, snatched the Balladeer back, and no matter how the Balladeer cried and threw a fit Jingyuanyuan would not budge. Unexpectedly, the trash can did not give up; after a hundred years of bitter training it finally mastered its divine skill on the seventh day of the seventh month, and strode all the way up the Magpie Bridge to storm the Heavenly Palace. It fought Jingyuanyuan to the death; the Balladeer shed tears, unable to watch the people who mattered most destroy each other over him, so he swallowed a pill and flew up to the moon. Alone, he endured thousands of years of loneliness.

Let's not talk about anything else, let's talk about Huawei's waterproofing. Last time my Huawei fell into the Mariana Trench, I thought the phone was definitely done for - either water would get in or the water pressure would burst it. What I never expected was that my Huawei used its Leica lens as eyes, automatically turned on the flashlight to light up the seafloor, used the phone's GPS as navigation, relied on the streamlined feel of the metal body, and kept paddling with the phone's vibration, and actually found me again! The warmth radiating from the Kirin 8-core CPU meant that when I got my Huawei back it wasn't cold to the touch, but slightly warm. At that moment, I truly felt the warmth of the motherland. I entered the great Huawei in this life, and in the next I'll still be Chinese. Next let's talk about Huawei's flash. Now I don't even wear a headlamp when I go mining - as soon as I take out my phone, the whole mine lights up. The signal is super strong. I remember one time our mine flooded and collapsed, over 6000 meters underground, and none of the 500+ coworkers' phones had signal. I took out my Huawei and made the emergency call. And Huawei's battery is awesome. When the rescue workers found us, the power had gone out due to the collapse, and they used ropes to pull up over 200 people. But suddenly a secondary collapse happened, and if we didn't rescue people quickly, it would all be over. I took the battery out of my Huawei and hooked up the elevator, and suddenly the whole mine had power. The elevator roared - before, it could only pull 10 people at a time, but with a Huawei battery it pulled over 50, and in 5 minutes everyone was rescued. After saving everyone, they gave me the battery back; after putting it back in it was still at 98%.

buttonList.text:
This option adds a hidden screen layer that lets you move the mouse only by dragging. You can move the mouse while the log is visible, but you cannot scroll the log or tap anything
When enabled, a text hint appears slightly below the center of the screen
(This feature is still a work in progress; the joystick cannot be used while it is on)

Genshin official site: https://ys.mihoyo.com/main/m/
Recommended: open with FCL v1.1.8.2+ for better results

This widget faithfully recreates Genshin Impact's UI layout
If this is your first time, strongly enter the tutorial
(tap the "?" button at bottom-right of the entry screen, or third row third slot in the Paimon menu)
(or tap the top-left of the entry screen to enter the tutorial)
This widget leaves room for the left/right rounded corners in landscape
Strongly recommend enabling "Ignore Notch" in launcher settings

Feedback channels are open
If you have improvements or new feature ideas for this layout,
email hsrfaku@outlook.com

If loading stutters,
try the "Cloud Genshin Layout"
- it strips many useless features and loads faster

Drag the joystick to move around
Control the player at the bottom right

'↑' is jump, '<<' is sprint, '🗡️' is left-click attack, '□' is right-click place, the Anemo burst 'F' swaps the off-hand item, and the inverted triangle '▼' at the bottom right is the Shift sneak lock

Such great music, it cured my Oripathy, Pandemic infection, Stormcaller sickness, Vocalis worm infection, Collapse syndrome, Abstraction, Money infection, Radiance infection, Cyberpsychosis, Fear gas inhalation, Homesickness, Urban disease, Distortion, Slow shock, Zombification, Witchification, Mania, Honkai disease, Mara-struck, Ascendant loss of control, Hypothermia, Kala bacteria, and Contact fear ❤️‍🩹

Tap 🛠️ at the top right to open the FCL floating menu
Tap 🖱️ to enter mouse control mode
